definitions.explanation: An official examination and verification of accounts, processes, or compliance with rules and regulations.

examples.japanese: {会計|かいけい}{監査|かんさ}を{受|う}けた。
{監査|かんさ}{法人|ほうじん}が{書類|しょるい}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: The audit firm reviewed the documents.

examples.japanese: {内部|ないぶ}{監査|かんさ}で{問題|もんだい}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: Problems were found in the internal audit.

notes:
TYPES OF {監査|かんさ}:
- {外部監査|がいぶかんさ}: external audit
- {内部監査|ないぶかんさ}: internal audit
- {会計監査|かいけいかんさ}: financial/accounting audit
- {業務監査|ぎょうむかんさ}: operational audit

RELATED TERMS:
- {監査役|かんさやく}: auditor (corporate)
- {監査法人|かんさほうじん}: audit firm
- {監査報告書|かんさほうこくしょ}: audit report
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}: certified public accountant

CORPORATE GOVERNANCE:
In Japanese companies, {監査役|かんさやく} plays an important role in corporate governance, distinct from the board of directors.
